content.comment_body: I'm using a [product_name] and can't upload my program. I have the latest software version, and when I connect in Network Project mode, it recognizes my [product_name] module and operator device, but when I try to upload, the module isn't found. When I open the test connections window, there’s no network card listed—it appears blank! Is anyone able to assist with this issue?
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. If there's no network adapter displayed in the connection window, establishing a connection won't be possible. Which operating system are you using?
It's an older computer running Windows 7. We also have newer Macs, but I assume the software isn't compatible with those anymore?
Have you installed [product_name] software as an administrator? If not, please uninstall and then reinstall [product_name] software as an administrator.
I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling, but it still isn't working.
Could you provide a screenshot of the device manager showing the network adapters, similar to the example attached?
I've taken a screenshot using my iPhone.
When I press the refresh button, both my [product_name] module and operator device appear in the window, indicating communication between them.
Do you now see the NVIDIA nForce Networking Controller in [product_name] software? Has your issue been resolved?
No, the network card still doesn't show up in [product_name] software.
See the attachment. Are you referring to pressing the 'Refresh button'?
What are your PC's IP address and subnet mask?
Can you check for a network card driver update?
Your [product_name] module and PC are on different subnets. Change the IP address of your [product_name] module to 192.168.1.xxx. Do the same for the operator device.
That solved the issue—thanks a lot!
Great to hear that everything is working now.

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue was a connectivity problem where the software could not list any network adapters, preventing program uploads to the [product_name] hardware. Although the devices were detected after refreshing, the lack of visible network adapters in the connection window caused frustration and unsuccessful troubleshooting attempts, including software reinstallation and administrative setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects smooth and reliable connectivity between the programming software and hardware module, with automatic detection of network adapters to enable straightforward program uploading.
